layout formula: One focal person centered slightly off-axis, 2-3 supporting props, light background context, open lower corners.
composition zones: Top: seasonal cues; Center: face/body focal point; Mid-lower: hands/object; Edges: light framing motifs.
notes: Keep the focal person dominant and the background supportive.

layout formula: 3-5 people in a curved or circular arrangement, one clear focal interaction, simple background geometry. Indoor variant uses simple room geometry; outdoor variant uses trees, park edge, or garden as a low-detail backdrop.
composition zones: Top: wall, window, banners, or tree line kept minimal; Center: group interaction; Bottom: chairs, floor, ground, grounding objects.
white space rule: Keep background under 30 percent detail so figures stay readable.
notes: No crowd scenes; emotional clarity matters more than realism. Covers indoor meeting rooms and outdoor gatherings, picnics, cookouts, and shared garden work.

layout formula: Short centered quote with wide margins and seasonal border motifs on 2-4 sides.
composition zones: Top-third: quote; Outer frame: florals and symbols; Corners: accent clusters; Center whitespace preserved.
white space rule: Preserve at least 50 percent open space around text.
notes: Keep the phrase short enough to color around comfortably.

layout formula: One interior room with strong furniture silhouette, layered comfort objects, single anchor light source or window. No people.
composition zones: Top: wall art or window; Center: bed, chair, or table anchor; Lower: rug, books, slippers, plants.
white space rule: Avoid filling every surface with pattern; leave floors and walls partially open.
notes: Good for quiet pacing between social pages.

layout formula: 8-15 related motifs grouped in balanced clusters with breathing room between forms.
composition zones: Distributed clusters across the full page with one central anchor motif.
white space rule: Keep clean separations between motifs for easy coloring.
notes: Use as a pacing reset page. Motifs shift by season while retaining brand symbols.

layout formula: Single figure outdoors on a path, sidewalk, trail, dock, or shoreline with calm background depth and limited environmental clutter.
composition zones: Top: sky, trees, or buildings minimal; Center: figure; Lower: path, leaves, water, flowers, pavement texture.
white space rule: Keep large sky and path zones open to avoid density.
notes: Covers walking scenes and static outdoor grounding moments. Great recurring template across all three lines.

layout formula: Exactly 2-3 figures in close, readable interaction: seated together, standing side by side, or walking together. Anchor is a porch railing, patio edge, park or city bench, kitchen or dining table, shop chair, or shared task.
composition zones: Top: plants, string lights, window, or tree line; Center: the two figures and their shared focus; Bottom: floorboards, table, bench, path, or ground.
white space rule: Keep railing, walls, table, and ground simple enough for color fill.
notes: Renamed in the rebuild from 'Porch or Patio Conversation'. The defining feature is party size, not furniture: use it for every 2-3 person scene, whether seated, walking, or working side by side.

layout formula: Person seated indoors at a window with a journal, mug, or book; the outside view simplified to weather and one or two shapes; indoor comfort props nearby.
composition zones: Top: window frame and weather; Center: seated figure; Lower: blanket, book, mug, plant.
white space rule: The window view should stay simple and not compete with the figure.
notes: Reserved for scenes with an actual window or outside view. Indoor comfort scenes with no window go to TPL-01.

layout formula: One outdoor retreat space with a strong built anchor (patio, courtyard, balcony, garden bed) plus plants and seating. No people.
composition zones: Top: sky, string lights, pergola, or wall edge; Center: seating or planting anchor; Lower: paving, path, pots, ground plants.
white space rule: Keep sky, paving, and lawn zones broadly open; do not pattern every surface.
notes: Added in the rebuild. The outdoor counterpart to TPL-04, which is explicitly an interior template. Covers patios, courtyards, balconies, backyards, and community gardens.

layout formula: Seasonal border or repeating pattern frame with 4-8 comfort objects set inside it; flatter and more graphic than a symbol cluster.
composition zones: Full-page border or corner frames; Center: object grouping; Background: restrained repeating pattern or open white.
white space rule: Keep the center open enough to read as a resting page; pattern supports, never fills.
notes: Added in the rebuild. The Decorative page type appears 12 times in the tracker and had no template defined anywhere. Distinct from TPL-05: TPL-05 is scattered motif clusters, TPL-10 is border and pattern led.
